savingsRules.$comment: F1-D15. Rules in prose + checkable invariants. Class names follow the common 'hard saving' and 'cost avoidance' split; both terms exist in the glossary.

classes.definition: Reduction of actual spend against an agreed baseline, verifiable on invoices or order data.
A cost increase that was proposed or contractually possible and was prevented; no reduction of current spend.
Better contractual terms without a computable euro value (notice period, exit right, SLA credits).

invariants: Never add hard_saving and cost_avoidance into one total.
A saving needs a baseline (the validated current annual amount of the contract); without one the entry is abstain, not zero.
Count only the first 12 months as hard saving even if the deal is multi-year; later years are reported as 'projected' separately.
The same euro cannot be claimed by two levers: where levers overlap on the same contract the opportunity keeps the largest single lever, not the sum (F2-D04 non-additivity).
A figure the user declares (not from the tenant data) is labelled 'declared by the user' and not added to Savings Identified until confirmed (D7).
savingsRules.decisionsNeeded: Whether first-year-only is Raffa policy, and how multi-year effects are shown, is a product/finance decision; the 12-month rule is the common convention found in sources, not a Raffa rule. Listed in PENDING_REVIEW.md.

renewalWindows.$comment: F1-D16. Phases anchored to the repo default Renewals:Thresholds (days before notice deadline). Copy per phase is IT/EN/FR/ES/DE next-step wording; no figures. The sources recommend starting 90-180 days out and sending a data-driven ask roughly 60-75 days out; these are advisory heuristics, not rules.

nextSteps.it: Verifica utilizzo e proprietario del contratto; fissa l'obiettivo di risparmio.
nextSteps.en: Check usage and the contract owner; set the savings goal.
nextSteps.fr: Vérifiez l'usage et le responsable du contrat ; fixez l'objectif d'économie.
nextSteps.es: Revise el uso y el responsable del contrato; fije el objetivo de ahorro.
nextSteps.de: Nutzung und Vertragsverantwortlichen prüfen; Einsparziel festlegen.

nextSteps.it: Raccogli alternative e dati di utilizzo; scegli le leve di negoziazione.
nextSteps.en: Collect alternatives and usage data; choose the negotiation levers.
nextSteps.fr: Rassemblez des alternatives et les données d'usage ; choisissez les leviers.
nextSteps.es: Reúna alternativas y datos de uso; elija las palancas de negociación.
nextSteps.de: Alternativen und Nutzungsdaten sammeln; Verhandlungshebel auswählen.

nextSteps.it: Invia la richiesta al fornitore e conferma per iscritto le condizioni concordate.
nextSteps.en: Send the request to the supplier and confirm agreed terms in writing.
nextSteps.fr: Envoyez la demande au fournisseur et confirmez par écrit les conditions convenues.
nextSteps.es: Envíe la solicitud al proveedor y confirme por escrito las condiciones acordadas.
nextSteps.de: Anfrage an den Lieferanten senden und vereinbarte Konditionen schriftlich bestätigen.

nextSteps.it: Decidi: rinnovare, rinegoziare o inviare la disdetta prima del termine.
nextSteps.en: Decide: renew, renegotiate, or send notice before the deadline.
nextSteps.fr: Décidez : renouveler, renégocier ou envoyer le préavis avant l'échéance.
nextSteps.es: Decida: renovar, renegociar o enviar el preaviso antes del plazo.
nextSteps.de: Entscheiden: verlängern, nachverhandeln oder vor Fristende kündigen.
